title: Periodic Table 3D
description: Browse all 118 elements on a tactile 3D table, open any tile, and orbit an animated atom surrounded by detailed scientific properties.

prompt.objective: Build a tactile 3D periodic table that opens every element into an animated, data-rich atom view.

mintAssets.brief: Dark wood and pale plastic PBR board surfaces.
Subtle hover, zoom, flap, and atom-ambience cues.

experience: Browse all 118 elements and open each tile with a cinematic transition.
Orbit atoms, read grouped properties, and customize the table and sound.
prompt.visualDirection: Gallery-like black space, warm wood, colorful raised tiles, crisp type, and restrained atomic glow.

thumbnail.alt: A glossy wooden periodic table with 118 color-coded raised element tiles and a matching category board.

social.title: Periodic Table 3D
social.description: Open all 118 elements and explore animated atoms with detailed scientific properties.
